audience: support teams that maintain a HelpDocs knowledge base and review reader searches

useCases.title: Find the article that answers a question
useCases.text: Search the published articles, with relevance scores. Open the best match to read its body and category.

useCases.title: Find gaps from reader search terms
useCases.text: Get the search terms readers used in a period. Compare them with the most-viewed articles to find topics that lack an article.

useCases.title: Draft an article and publish it after review
useCases.text: Create an article as an unpublished draft in a category, then update the working copy. Publish it when the draft is ready for readers.

useCases.title: Review an article's edit history
useCases.text: List the saved versions of an article, newest first. Read the categories and their parents to find where an article belongs.

useCases.title: Reuse shared copy and variables
useCases.text: List the reusable clips and variables that articles embed, so shared copy is written once.
